comments.text: No laws' only functions because the community is tiny and tightly knit. In a place like this, social reputation is a far harsher judge than any court of law. Drop this model into a modern city and it collapses in under 24 hours.

comments.text: The sheer scale of the ocean surrounding this tiny rock in the middle of nowhere is absolutely mind-blowing! Watching those rugged volcanic cliffs clash with the endless blue waves really puts Earth's raw power into perspective. That untamed coastal landscape is pure paradise for any true explorer at heart!
